title: V21-10 的 CORE 内生依赖与项目级 Gate A 叠加门槛
decision: C09 remains the CORE-internal predecessor, while Gate A is an additional project-level hard start gate for C10. Contract or test preparation may proceed without claiming C10.
rationale: The formal CORE booklet defines C09 to C10, and the current Console program DAG adds Gate A before C10. Both constraints apply at their respective layers.
